turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Hello, I can help with that. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with. Once I have both, I can check the order and the delivery change.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.

Thank you, George. Your order SC-4040 has already shipped, and our policy only allows address changes until the order ships. I cannot change the delivery address for this order. You can follow the delivery here: https://curier.example/track/SC4040. If you need help with the parcel itself, reply here and I can tell you more about the options.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.
